title: 第30章 安怜：我们又是什么关系呢？
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
叶闻白坐在另一侧，目光沉沉地看着这一幕。

    视线从江彻揽着安怜的手上移到安怜埋在他胸口的那张脸上。

    他想起昨晚私家侦探发来的报告。

    安怜除了和他在一起之外，还和江彻、牧子临同时保持着关系。

    不光是他，另外两人都是她的男朋友，三人都被蒙在鼓里。

    他看到这份报告的时候，以

    “好了，我也不聊了，我看会儿资料！”周海也结束了话题学习了起来。

    简晗只盯着前面，忽然想起来，自己母亲在医院，她一怔，不想母亲看到靳司丞，又不好意思说。

    “这房子都是你的了……需要东西由你自己准备不好吗？”他的时间也是很宝贵的好不好？

    两家公司合并后，原有的MK公司就变成了MQ公司的总部，而秦氏集团则变成了MQ公司的分公司，两家公司隶属上下级之分，但经营模式和核算方式还是相对独立，和以前几乎没有差别。

    记者会随着他这一记重击，终于落下了帷幕，大部分记者都兴高采烈的走了，只有少数的开始担忧自己回公司还有没有一席之地。

    说着，舒晓峰手指轻弹间，当即便是将两枚已经成熟的龙血果投掷了出去。

    “裴晨宇，你给我听清楚，你我毫无关系，你要脸面就不要再来这里烦扰我哥和我妈，你如果不要，我就索性给你扯下来。”简晗不想妥协了。

    “对，我知道。”穆璟戈面容凝固，他自己在穆氏呆了这么几个月，早就听说了许多有关于穆氏的风言风语。

    在吸收了这团灵力白烟之后，舒晓峰体内的灵力，瞬间便是达到了顶峰。

    若是有一日她公主的身份被人知道，持鞭打人的行为还是容易引人置喙的，于名声而言终归不好。

    相承将头颅微微抬起，一言不发，只目光灼灼地望向相山河，气势如虹。

    傀二的拳头迅猛地轰在了崔封的胸膛之上。孟岩软甲一阵抖动，卸去了大部分的力量，但崔封依然被轰飞出去，喉咙之中涌上了一阵甜意。

    拼命凝聚灵力，崔封才堪堪再度稳住了身子，重新平稳地飞行了起来。

    “王爷，海军基地的事可以告一段落了，我们现在该去西南闯一闯了”陈宁目视着远方说道。

    “师意，如果有一天你发现，所有的事情都不是你想象的那么美好，你会不会对这个世界失望？”孙长江拉着师意的手，意味深长的说。

    不知道是有意还是无意，董占云看了一眼地下的坑洞最深处，竟然让他发现了一缕灵动的火苗。刚开始的时候董占云还以为是自己在攻击冰雪怪物所遗留的一丝火苗，所以也没太在意。

    云峰不解，按理说三古之祖败落，没有了这三位，即便这三族再强，那也绝对不是万族和战神族的敌手!

    “是，是费良言他非说你欺骗他，说你有一个初恋男友不告诉他。我怎么劝他也不听我的！”路瞳看着师意，着急委屈的差点哭出来。

    如果辰逸想要趁人之危，那么在药力发作的时候无疑的最好的，可那时候辰逸都没有对她做什么，也就让柳璃释然了。

    这也是强求不来的事情，毕竟教育这东西没有个十年的功夫是根本看不出效果的，而想要真正自成体系，只怕是需要几代人的努力和投入才能逐渐见到效果。
content_en:
Ye Wenbai sat on the other side, watching this scene with a heavy gaze.

    His eyes moved from Jiang Che's hand holding An Lian to An Lian's face buried in his chest.

    He remembered the report sent by the private detective last night.

    In addition to being with him, An Lian also maintained relationships with Jiang Che and Mu Zilin.

    Not only him, but the other two were her boyfriends, and all three of them were kept in the dark.

    When he saw this report, he thought

    "Okay, I won't talk anymore, I'll read the information for a while!" Zhou Hai also ended the topic and started studying.

    Jian Han just stared ahead and suddenly remembered that her mother was in the hospital. She was startled because she didn't want her mother to see Jin Sicheng and was too embarrassed to say anything.

    "This house belongs to you...can't you prepare the things you need yourself?" His time is also precious, okay?

    After the merger of the two companies, the original MK Company became the headquarters of MQ Company, while Qin Group became a branch of MQ Company. The two companies are subordinate to each other, but their business models and accounting methods are still relatively independent, and there is almost no difference from before.

    With this heavy blow from him, the press conference finally came to an end. Most of the reporters left happily, but only a few began to worry about whether they would have a place back in the company.

    As he spoke, Shu Xiaofeng threw two ripe dragon blood fruits with a flick of his fingers.

    "Pei Chenyu, please listen to me clearly. You and I have nothing to do with each other. If you want to save face, don't come here to bother my brother and my mother again. If you don't want to, I will simply tear them off for you." Jian Han didn't want to compromise anymore.

    "Yes, I know." Mu Jingge's face solidified. He had stayed in Mu's for so many months and had heard many rumors about Mu's.

    After absorbing this white smoke of spiritual power, the spiritual power in Shu Xiaofeng's body reached its peak in an instant.

    If her identity as a princess were to be known one day, her behavior of beating people with a whip would easily attract people's attention, and it would not be good for her reputation after all.

    Xiangcheng raised his head slightly and said nothing. He only looked at Xiangshanhe with burning eyes, his aura was like a rainbow.

    Puppet Er's fist quickly hit Cui Feng's chest. Meng Yan's soft armor shook for a while, losing most of its power, but Cui Feng was still blasted away, and a sweet feeling surged in his throat.

    After desperately concentrating his spiritual power, Cui Feng was able to stabilize his body again and fly smoothly again.

    "Your Majesty, the matter at the naval base has come to an end. Now it's time for us to venture into the southwest," Chen Ning said, looking into the distance.

    "Shi Yi, if one day you find that everything is not as beautiful as you imagined, will you be disappointed in this world?" Sun Changjiang took Shi Yi's hand and said meaningfully.

    Whether intentionally or unintentionally, Dong Zhanyun glanced at the deepest part of the underground pit, and he discovered a wisp of live flames. At first, Dong Zhanyun thought it was a trace of fire left behind by attacking the ice and snow monster, so he didn't pay much attention to it.

    Yunfeng was puzzled. It stands to reason that the ancestors of the Three Ancients were defeated. Without these three people, no matter how strong these three tribes were, they would definitely not be the opponents of the Ten Thousand Tribes and the God of War Tribe!

    "Yes, it's Fei Liangyan. He insists that you cheated on him and didn't tell him that you had a first love boyfriend. No matter how I tried to persuade him, he wouldn't listen to me!" Lu Tong looked at Shiyi and almost cried with worry and grievance.

    If Chen Yi wanted to take advantage of someone's danger, it would be best to do it when the medicine was taking effect, but Chen Yi didn't do anything to her at that time, which made Liu Li relieved.

    This is also something that cannot be forced. After all, education will not be effective if it does not take ten years. To truly form a system, it will only take several generations of efforts and investment to gradually see the effects.
title_en: Chapter 30 An Lian: What is our relationship?
